title: Von Frey Test for Mechanical Sensitivity in Mice
author: Sunamita Lima
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p7zdrp6

steps.title: Habituate Mice to Testing Enclosure
steps.instruction: Allow mice 30 minutes of habituation to a Plexiglas enclosure (9 cm L × 5 cm W × 5 cm H) featuring a wire-mesh floor (aquarium/vivarium top) instead of a glass floor.

steps.title: Administer Crotamine Injection
steps.instruction: Perform intraplantar injection of crotamine at a dose of 1 or 5 µg/animal paw.

steps.title: Measure Mechanical Sensitivity Thresholds
steps.instruction: Assess mechanical sensitivity thresholds using calibrated Von Frey nylon monofilaments, applying pressure to the plantar surface of the hindpaw until the fiber bends.

substeps.instruction: Use a set of calibrated fibers ranging from 0.1 g to 80 g of pressure force (approximately 18 g are applied).
Determine the threshold force required to elicit paw withdrawal (median 50% paw withdrawal) using the up–down method.
Repeat stimulation until the animal presents two similar measures.
Perform all testing blind to the group designation.

steps.title: Establish Testing Timeline
steps.instruction: Conduct the Von Frey tests at three specific time points: before the injection (basal measure), 15 minutes after injection, and 30 minutes after injection.
